**Date of Agreement:** July 24, 2025

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Adeia Inc. (f/k/a Xperi Holding Corporation), a Delaware corporation

**Transaction Description:** This is a joinder agreement whereby Adeia Semiconductor Inc. (f/k/a Xcelsis Corporation) is joining as an additional guarantor and pledgor to an existing security agreement. The transaction involves Adeia Semiconductor Inc. becoming bound by the terms of a Security Agreement originally dated June 1, 2020, with Bank of America, N.A. serving as Collateral Agent.

**Purpose of Financing:** N/A - The document does not specify the original purpose of the underlying financing facility.

**Company Background:** Adeia Inc. is the borrower under the existing credit facility. Adeia Semiconductor Inc., previously known as Xcelsis Corporation, is a Delaware corporation that is now joining the credit arrangement as a guarantor and pledgor. Both entities appear to operate in the semiconductor/technology sector based on their names and locations in San Jose, California.

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Enhanced credit support through additional guarantor joining the facility
• Comprehensive security package with "all assets" pledge from the new guarantor
• Established banking relationship with Bank of America as collateral agent
• Broad collateral coverage including intellectual property, equity interests, and real property
• New guarantor bound by all existing covenants and obligations retroactively

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• Limited visibility into underlying credit agreement terms and financial performance
• Technology sector exposure may present volatility risks
• Complexity of guarantor structure with multiple entities and name changes
• Mitigation: Comprehensive UCC filings and perfected security interests in all assets
• Mitigation: Experienced institutional lender (Bank of America) as collateral agent
